title: REJECT commits: the run is rejected with the reason, a REVISION successor run is minted, approval decisions carry a verdict
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-6061e05cd17540a1bbe08b965da58b64 (leaf; no sibling dependency). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 68eb1c5d.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the durable REJECT decision and the record that lets everything downstream find the goal's CURRENT run. No offer-ladder, compiler, wrapper or UI change (children 2-3).

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts (244 lines): DECISIONS = ["APPROVE","REJECT"] at :91; the intent shape {decision, decisionReason: string|null, dependencyChanges, runId} (:116-137); the only REJECT handling is `if (intent.decision !== "APPROVE") return refuse(null, "BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID", "DAEMON_PREREQUISITE")` at :196-198 BEFORE the fences/sources/human-review witness (:200-243) - pinned by approval-intent.test.ts:1273-1280 and :1565-1567 (both re-aimed by this row). APPROVE runs: source fences (:202-207), `readApprovalIntentSources` (:212), the HUMAN_APPROVED witness `input.humanReview` + operatorReviewAuthority (:218-231), then `commitIntentActivation` (:243, approval-intent-activation.ts). The file is at 244 lines: the REJECT commit goes in a NEW module `approval-intent-rejection.ts` (+ .js bridge), approval-intent.ts only branches to it after the SAME witness/fence checks (a REJECT is a human decision exactly like APPROVE).
- Core designed path: packages/core/src/planning/planning-results.ts:132 `rejectRun(state, commandId, findingsRef, successorRunId)` -> run lifecycle REJECTED (+ successorRunId on the event, :141-146) and returns `successor` = a DRAFT state for `successorRunId` (successorData :118-130; INITIAL/REVISION share the carrier). Run lifecycles: packages/contracts/src/runtime/runtime-vocabulary.ts:49-50 (DRAFT, READY, PLANNING, SUBMISSION_DRAINING, PLAN_REVIEW, APPROVED, ACTIVATED, REJECTED, CANCELLED). `planning.create_draft` with `runKind: "REVISION"` needs only {goalRef, runId, runKind} (planning-command-contract.ts:160-167). Multi-aggregate commits ride one `commitExpectedVersionDecisionLegs` (see apps/daemon/src/planning/graph-activation-service.ts:41).
- The goal's run: the durable goal state carries ONE immutable `planningRunRef` (read at apps/daemon/src/http/affordance-planning-offers.ts:88); `planReviewable(ledger, runId)` (:78-81) keys on the run lifecycle. Nothing today follows a REJECTED run to its successor.
- Activity: apps/daemon/src/http/activity-read.ts:77 VERDICT_KINDS = {escalation.decide, review.submit}; `verdictOf(commandKind, resultBytes)` (:80) reads the committed result; apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-words.ts:69 ALREADY renders "approved the plan" / "rejected the plan" for an approval verdict - the server never emits one.

FEATURE: (1) `approval.decide_intent {decision:"REJECT", decisionReason, runId}` passes the same fences + sources + human-review witness as APPROVE, then commits ONE multi-leg decision: core `rejectRun` on the run aggregate (findingsRef = sha256 over "moe-plan-rejection/1\n" + reason; successorRunId = a deterministic id derived from runId + commandId) AND a `PlanningRunCreated` REVISION event for the successor (goalRef = the run's goal) so the successor exists at version 1; the intent decision's committed result is {decision:"REJECT", decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId}. An empty/whitespace reason refuses APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED (layer DAEMON_PREREQUISITE) before any durable read; a run not in PLAN_REVIEW refuses with the existing sources/lifecycle code. (2) `currentPlanningRun(ledger, goal)` in a new module apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts (+.js): starts at goal.planningRunRef and follows lifecycle REJECTED -> successorRunId (bounded to 16 hops, cycle-safe, unreadable -> the original ref) returning {runId, hops, rejected: [{runId, successorRunId}]}. (3) activity-read.ts VERDICT_KINDS gains approval.decide_intent (and approval.decide) reading `result.decision`.
definitionOfDone: Over a REAL store driven to PLAN_REVIEW (the fixtures approval-intent.test.ts already uses): `approval.decide_intent` REJECT with a reason and the human-review witness commits; the run aggregate reads lifecycle REJECTED with the successorRunId, the successor run aggregate reads DRAFT at version 1 with runKind REVISION and the same goalRef, and the intent decision result decodes to {decision, decisionReason, findingsRef, runId, successorRunId} (exact keys).

Refusal arms with code + layer: empty/whitespace reason -> APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED before any store read (the existing 'refuses REJECT before looking up a durable run' arm at :1273 is re-aimed to this); REJECT without the human-review witness -> APPROVAL_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED (same as APPROVE); REJECT on a run already REJECTED or ACTIVATED -> the existing lifecycle/sources code; an MCP caller cannot reject (the MCP-excluded arm for approval.decide_intent unchanged, count line quoted). The APPROVE path is byte-identical: every existing APPROVE arm green unchanged.

`currentPlanningRun` test: original run -> REJECTED -> successor -> REJECTED -> successor resolves to the last one with hops 2 and both rejected ids; a cycle or an unreadable run resolves to the original ref without throwing; the bridge `.js` exists and the module is exported from apps/daemon/src/index.ts (index-surface EXPECTED_EXPORTS re-pinned by running it red first).
`/activity/read` entries for approval.decide_intent carry verdict APPROVE or REJECT read from the committed result (activity-read.test.ts arm per verdict); decisions of other kinds keep verdict null.
Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`; approval-intent.ts stays <= 250 lines (`wc -l` quoted) - the reject commit lives in approval-intent-rejection.ts.
taskRails: HUMAN GATE: REJECT rides the operator-only, MCP-excluded approval wire and requires the same HUMAN_APPROVED witness as APPROVE; a test pins that an MCP caller cannot reject. Never mint a rejection without the witness.
PURE DAEMON LEAF: no offer-ladder, compiler, wrapper, catalog-shape or UI change; if a step needs one, stop and say so (child 2/3).

Refusals assert code AND layer; mutate the surface to prove each arm red (global rail 1). <=250 physical lines per production source, hard stop 400; a new refusal code is added only where its roster pins are named in the plan.

implementationPlan.description: RESOLVER. NEW apps/daemon/src/planning/current-planning-run.ts (<=250 lines) + bridge .js. Export `currentPlanningRun(store: SqliteEventStore, planningRunRef: string): CurrentPlanningRun` with `CurrentPlanningRun = Readonly<{ runId: string; hops: number; rejected: readonly Readonly<{ runId: string; successorRunId: string }>[]; unreadable: boolean }>` and a pure `foldCurrentRun(readEvents: (runId) => readonly StoredEvent[] | null, planningRunRef)` the store variant delegates to (the pure fold is what the hops-2 / cycle / unreadable arms drive). Never throw: a throwing `readEvents` yields the original ref with unreadable:true. Frozen result. Import it relatively (no daemon root export - comment on this row).
